relations.subject: J. C. De
relations.role: temporary Assistant Secretary (in charge of the Library)
relations.evidence: Mr. J. C. De, the temporary Assistant Secretary (in charge of the Library), resigned with effect from January

relations.subject: S. K. Saraswati
relations.evidence: Mr. De was replaced by Mr. S. K. Saraswati, M.A., who had been doing part-time work in the Library since January, 1943, and was appointed Librarian

relations.subject: Trin Chen
relations.evidence: Mr. Trin Chen, our Sino-Tibetan clerk since 1939, was in indifferent health for some time, and he died in service in December.

relations.subject: Sivasankara Mitra
relations.evidence: Mr. Sivasankara Mitra, M.A., was appointed cataloguer on a salary of Rs.100 per month

relations.subject: M. C. Nath
relations.evidence: The prize for 1941 was awarded to Dr. M. C. Nath of the Dacca University.

relations.subject: Birajasanker Guha
relations.evidence: The medal was awarded to Dr. Birajasanker Guha, Anthropologist to the Zoological Survey of India.
